name: Nakagawa Ken'ya
source:
Misato's former student and class president. Serious and cool-headed. He seems to admire Misato and willingly takes on the duties of class president.

He thinks it's a secret crush, but everyone else can see right through her.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698875&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
